Spirit revival/re-summoning remains pending because retrieved official guide does not establish the limit.

fixes: Real allowlisted HTTPS retrieval with official priority
Public DNS pinning, redirects validated, size/time/rate/origin limits
Two-pass generation and JSON evidence review
Exact quote attribution required; unsupported blocks hidden in favor of pending reason
Truncated API responses rejected; review failure not reported as success

No fabricated source URLs; mixed pending blocks retain reference links

limitations: Evidence matching uses AI semantic judgment and is not a guarantee of truth
Some Elden Ring documents are 2021/2022 material; present-day patch differences remain a limitation
Unknown detail is intentionally withheld; comparison is incomplete where weapon-specific evidence is missing

Local source service requires node server.cjs; static-only/offline use is marked pending
Real API samples preceded the final cosmetic fixes to pending-reason truncation, timestamp label and box wrapping; those fixes are covered by final regression and real-output replay
privacy: No API key was read into tool output or saved in artifacts; source service receives only game/question, not DeepSeek authorization
